record.question: Which of the following Agency regulates the working of the share markets in India?
record.explanation: Answer B: SEBI. The Securities and Exchange Board of India is the statutory regulator for India’s securities markets. The other choices are not the securities-market regulatory agency. Reference: https://www.sebi.gov.in/about-sebi.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: PART-A (150 Marks). All questions carry equal marks of 2 each. Attempt all questions. This Section should be answered only on the OMR Response Sheet provided.
